title: ambi_reduced_decode_fft2
description: `ambi_reduced_decode_fft2` calculates a reduced set of HRTF spectra for Ambisonic binaural decoding by forming a decoder matrix from real and phantom loudspeaker positions, computing its pseudoinverse, and applying its columns to left-ear HRIRs followed by a real FFT. A key usage detail is that `calc_pinv` starts matrix encoding, while `calc_reduced` with an Ambisonic channel index generates that channel’s reduced decoder data.
